create_flat_hash_set: create a FlatHashSet instance to deduplicate numpy uint64 hash arrays with batched operations
add_hashes_to_set: add numpy arrays of uint64 hashes to a FlatHashSet and get a boolean contains array back
merge_hash_sets: merge keys and values from one hash set into another using the merge method
dump_load_hash_set: dump a FlatHashSet to disk as numpy arrays and load it back into a new set
compare_load_performance: run compare_load to benchmark dump and load performance across gp, np, and np2 formats
